section_anchor: Five storefronts, five regions, one open date
brief_summary: Five-box glyph strip, one box per vendor/region pairing, all rendered in the same coral fill to signal a simultaneous launch rather than a staggered regional rollout: Keebz N Cables (Oceania), Divinikey (United States), Prototypist (United Kingdom), KBDfans (China), Unikeys (Canada), each labelled with the shared August 18, 2026 open date.
